name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the EU's urban wastewater rules, which require extra treatment to remove medicine and cosmetics residues from wastewater. It asks the European Commission to pause the fees that medicine and cosmetics makers pay towards this treatment, until a new independent study checks the real costs and effects on medicine supplies, jobs and local water companies.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for a pause on industry fees and a new study by early 2027.
- **Who it affects:** Medicine and cosmetics makers, local water companies, patients and EU manufacturers.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must decide whether to act on these requests.
